## 已发表知识与材料观察

来源论文摘要报告：通过相位型空间光调制器工程化微米尺度偏振统计，实现可编程SOP与DOP，并用于高维光信息编码（https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10891-z）。这是已发表知识，不是本轮发现。材料含两种不同扫描，不能当作独立重复，也不能混合DOP导出尺度。

完整CSV的spread组102行中，DOP均值57.17、范围8.42–93.14（该图导出约0–100）；归一化S1/S2/S3平方范数均值0.999993，范围0.999944–0.999998。mean_phase组是另一条扫描，DOP约0–1。字段检查说明方向分量与DOP标量不是同一数值编码，不能据此推断仪器过程。

## 概念学习与算例

在常见横向偏振Stokes描述中，四元组(S0,S1,S2,S3)以S0表征总强度，后三项表征偏振分量。常用DOP为sqrt(S1²+S2²+S3²)/S0。若再把后三项归一化为方向向量(s1,s2,s3)，其模长在分母非零时按定义为1；因此方向归一化会丢弃幅度信息，方向模长不能充当DOP。

学习用算例（非本数据推断）：两个等强、完全偏振子束的Stokes向量为(1,1,0,0)和(1,0,1,0)，探测器对其作非相干等权平均。平均Stokes为(1,0.5,0.5,0)，DOP=1/sqrt(2)≈0.707；再归一化的方向为(1/sqrt(2),1/sqrt(2),0)，模仍为1。该例依赖先平均Stokes的非相干平均假设，不说明本实验实际采用同一测量过程。

## 暂定解释与未知

条件性解释：相位分布展宽若改变被平均的局部偏振态混合程度，可能改变DOP；方向变量经归一化仍可有近单位模。表格与此描述相容，但不识别具体原因。

我目前不能解释SLM相位统计如何映射到空间采样及探测平均，也不能确认dphi单位、DOP校准、Stokes重建流程或不确定度。因此不能将单一扫描的DOP变化归因于特定物理机制。

                    Spatial light modulation is a cornerstone of modern photonics. Crucial advances in photonic information processing
                     1–3

                     13–27

By engineering the polarization statistics at the micrometre scale with a phase-only spatial light modulator, we realize more than 1,024 spatial modes with fully programmable SOP and DOP. Polarization colours expand the dimensionality of optical computing and encryption schemes, as demonstrated by (1) fully parallel photonic classification of colour images by a high-dimensional photonic neural network and (2) high-security multidimensional optical encryption. function.name: read_document
function.description: Read a supplied immutable document, including omitted context. JSON pointer selects a section; pagination never silently truncates. raw=true returns original text for quotations.

function.name: read_documents
function.description: Read several needed documents in one call to avoid repeated model round-trips. Each page has explicit next_offset and SHA. Total requested characters must be at most 24000.

function.name: analyze_csv
function.description: Compute on the ENTIRE registered CSV (not preview rows). Numeric column names are arrays. scan selections use group_column/group_value. Define variables in order and output safe array expressions. Functions: abs,sqrt,sin,cos,mean,sum,std,min,max,median,quantile,isfinite,where,clip,diff(axis=0),norm(axis=-1),shift,rolling. No Python execution or file access.

function.name: submit_result
function.description: Submit the complete stage result as an object. Local validators return precise repair instructions before any question or memory state is committed.
